verdict.rationale: Omarchy's docs state that full-disk encryption is mandatory, so disk encryption itself is a first-party, default capability. Nothing in the evidence says the encryption is TPM-backed or uses hardware key storage, which is the defining part of this story. missing for 10: any documentation of TPM-backed key sealing or unlock (e.g. systemd-cryptenroll/TPM2 enrollment), hardware-encryption configuration steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can encrypt my disk using TPM-backed hardware encryption
